user_questions.question: Two scope choices (deletes are hard to undo): (1) Account.Total_Storefronts__c: maintain it as the count of Storefront__c per Account via record-triggered flows (recommended; Storefront__c.Account__c is a lookup with 21 records, and 10 Accounts already hold correct seeded counts) or delete it? (2) Account.Total_Orders__c: delete it (recommended; 0 values, Order has 0 records, orders live in an external API), populate it from the external Orders API (needs an integration), or keep it untouched?
user_questions.simulated_answer: Make Total Storefronts work (maintain count); delete Total Orders since there's no order model.

skill_friction: Step 5 says 'if the requirement's wording points to one option, take it' but the requirement explicitly offers 'either make them work or delete them' for two fields; it is unclear whether an explicit either/or in the requirement counts as user-delegated choice (decide) or an ambiguous Delete set (ask). I asked because deletes are hard to undo.

Premise was partly false (10 Accounts have seeded, correct values) and AskCoworker D1/D2 claimed 0 non-null values from a 'prior session'; the skill handles this, but there is no guidance on whether a partly-false premise that does not change the inventory needs its own Section 1 statement versus Section 8.

Spec-format says flow-only changes use FlowTest or manual checks but does not say whether FlowTest components should be added to the inventory by default; Flow Tests cannot cover before-delete flows, so I used recommended verification only.
org-verification.md lists FlexiPage without saying it needs the Tooling API; the standard-API query failed.
No allowed command can read report or list view columns, so a field Delete always carries an unverifiable reports/list views prerequisite; the skill does not say whether that should be blocking.
